data.name: Birrah
data.gender_notes: Birrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-h', meaning 'to fear' or 'to serve'. A person named Birrah is one who is devoted to Allah and strives to follow His commands. The name Birrah carries the meaning “A servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Birrah usually hope their child will grow to embody a servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Servant of Allah, one who fears and obeys God.
data.etymology: Birrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Birrah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: بيره

in_urdu.name: بیرہ
